name: External Identity Provider Sign-In Access Denied
summary: An anonymous user selects a supported external identity provider but cancels the provider ceremony or denies the requested authorization, so no NuvIoT durable identity is resolved and the user receives a recoverable access-denied outcome.
finalOutcome: No durable identity or normal application session is established, and the user can retry provider sign-in or choose email authentication.

sourceReferences.note: External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
